references.title: 秋谷游历图
references.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Design a BEAUTIFUL premium portrait mobile Chinese paper-cut fantasy game's CHAPTER LEVEL SELECT screen for 灵狐绘卷. The provided screenshot is ONLY a reference for the game's existing flat cut-paper red sun, angular mountain palette and Chinese aesthetic. DISCARD ITS ENTIRE RECTANGULAR GRID UI. The user strongly dislikes its repeated card rows. This is a completely new immersive map composition. NEVER make a grid, table, tile array, numbered rows, two equal columns, rectangular nameplates beside each level, or horizontal zigzag ladder. Make a single continuous illustrated pilgrimage route, flowing naturally from foreground bottom to distant top, through distinct mountain/island landmarks, with exactly ten small numbered interactable seals distributed at IRREGULAR distances and offset positions. Some nodes sit on distant ridges, some at shrine bridges. Each level is a small round cinnabar stamp or bead or star, not a card. Small unobtrusive Chinese names are printed DIRECTLY beside seals, WITHOUT boxes or plates. Clear hierarchy: about 75% evocative illustrated chapter map, 10% quiet chapter navigation, 15% ONE selected-level detail and one primary enter button at bottom. No repetitive card layout anywhere. Gorgeous flat 2D Chinese layered paper-cut, ink wash accents, original ornamental carved silhouettes, atmospheric depth, broad deliberate negative space, tasteful gold fine lines, no photorealism, no 3D, no neon, no HUD health bar, no player combat arena. Readable clean Chinese typography, tiny navigation at top "入画山海", four subtle chapter symbols, elegant vertical chapter calligraphy integrated into the scenery. A small fox paper token marks the selected starting node at bottom-left. Nodes 05 and 10 have bigger shrine/guardian symbols. Realistic playable mobile UI, no phone frame, no watermark. Bottom panel should feel like the edge of an illustrated hanging scroll and not a SaaS card; text "第一境 · 落笔秋径" and single red or chapter-accent button "落笔入画". ONE full-size portrait 9:16 screen. Chapter title "落日妖谷". A winding mountain pilgrimage: large vermilion sun in distant cream sky, amber and burgundy autumn ridges, a red shrine gate at the summit, maple groves, elegant old stone bridges and a pale golden trail crossing between several ridges. The trail rises diagonally and changes direction organically; nodes do NOT align to rows or columns. Ten tiny cinnabar circular seal markers read 01 through 10 in ascending order from bottom to top. Selected node 01 near a small fox at foreground bottom-left; node 10 sits before distant summit gate. Use full illustrated mountain topography all the way down to the bottom panel, NO empty flat dark combat courtyard. Quiet gold branch/leaf details confined to edges. Keep the sun and mountain silhouettes dominant, path gently luminous with discrete progress segments. Warm restrained cinnabar, parchment, ochre, charcoal. High-end art-director quality, immediately distinct from the supplied screenshot's ugly grid.
